params.text: Durable recovery acceptance marker s5-fresh-recovery-isolated. Use exactly one tool call per model turn. First call bash with `sleep 20; mkdir -p e2e; printf '%s\n' 's5-fresh-recovery-isolated' > e2e/s5-fresh-recovery-isolated.txt`. After that bash call returns, stop and wait for the next model turn; do not call read in the same turn. On the next turn call the read tool on e2e/s5-fresh-recovery-isolated.txt, then reply with exactly s5-fresh-recovery-isolated.
